```yaml
name: Publish Fern Docs
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish-fern-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        
      - name: Install fern
        run: |
          cargo install fern
          
      - name: Generate Fern Documentation
        run: |
          fern generate --docs --preview
          
      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "docs: update fern documentation"
          branch: main
          push: true
```
